manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Accept a target confirmation-form PDF from a current prefecture official index even when the WordPress upload path contains a prior calendar year.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Follow the link labeled 申請書.
Verify the linked PDF is a target form body for the school, and treat the current prefecture index as FY2026 evidence.
Do not treat the /uploads/2025/06/ path segment as an explicit stale fiscal-year label.

reusable_rules: For prefecture_aggregator disclosure URLs, accept a target-form body using prefecture_index_current_year when the candidate URL only contains a bare upload/calendar year.
Preserve year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year so the accepted path is auditable.
Continue rejecting candidates whose anchor or URL explicitly says 2025年度 or 令和7年度.
anti_patterns: Do not use the crawl date as year evidence.
Do not let a bare /uploads/2025/06/ path override a current official-index handoff when the PDF body is target.
Do not override explicit stale fiscal-year labels such as 2025年度.

evidence.notes: v242 rejected this PDF as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 because the WordPress upload path contains 2025/06. Current-code replay after the upload-year trust fix downloads it with year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year, then ingestion preserves document_fiscal_year=2026 while the parser sees internal 2025 term dates.
